messages:
leo: Quick flag  Orion Health active calls down ~43% WoW since onboarding handoff. Telemetry: https://redwood.internal/telemetry/orion (big drops on /chat and /embeddings).

maria: Looking - runbook shows SSO flip completed 2025-04-02 but no final smoke sign-off recorded.

sam: AE update  procurement said a competitor demo is slotted for next Fri. This could accelerate churn if we dont act.

dina: I can pull a seat-by-seat CSV + per-route P95/P99 latency. @leo which endpoints are core for them?

leo: Core: `POST /v1/chat` (customer UI flows), `POST /v1/embeddings` (batch indexing), plus their reranker hitting the dedicated queue.

maria: Correlation: auth errors (401) and elevated 504s around 2025-04-02T22:45Z immediately after the SSO cutover. Pushing log snippets to drive.

elena: (Customer) "Some users saw conversations drop and intermittent 401s; chat latency spiked." Elena is on-thread.

sam: Proposed immediate plays:
1) Scoped API-key fallback for a named service account to restore sessions quickly.
2) Offer a 10-day dedicated burst pool to stabilize latency while we triage.
3) Exec-level sync with Elena + procurement this Thu to show plan and ROI.

dina: I'll model burst pool cost delta and expected P95/P99 gains by EOD and export a CSV for seats impacted.

maria: I'll prep a condensed canary/rollback plan and rehearse hitless rollback in staging. Need access approvals from the customer.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20250402-ORION-AUTH created for elevated auth failures and error rate. PD notified.

leo: Owners: @sam  API-key fallback + customer comms; @dina  cost & metric modelling; @maria  rollback rehearsal & canary. I'll own the exec brief slides.

elena: Thanks for the quick reaction. We'll join the exec sync if you can show a short mitigation timeline.

sam: I'll draft a short runbook snippet for temporary keys and post here for review.

dina: CSV shared via DM to owners with tagged seats that dropped.

leo: Goal: present mitigations + cost delta Tue AM to preempt the competitor demo on Fri. :thumbsup: 

maria: Agreed  will follow up with a customer-facing note after the exec sync."
